paragraphs.text: Casindral Isle is the southernmost island belonging to the continent of Corondor , located south of the Cape of Casindral , about midway between Stonehaven and Golthonor .

Mariners have long hailed this island as one of fair omen, for to pass it by sea is to be taken by the current at twice the speed of the southern albatross. It was from this good harbor that merchant ships, pleasure craft, and pirate vessels launched, for anywhere on Corondor’s Southern Coast was reachable from here. This was also the landing point for unfortunate refugees from the troubles in the tropical land of Jamuura .
